events.title: Explain Echoes From Scratch
must_haves: One approximately 10-second vertical video includes intelligible English voice-over.
The narration explains that sound reflects off a surface and returns to the listener.
The visuals show sound traveling from a source to a surface and back toward the listener.
The explanation uses simple, child-friendly language and finishes without cutting off the narration.
The visual sound journey and the spoken explanation agree.

answer_sheet.Topic and audience: Why we hear echoes, explained simply for kids.

events.text: Could you make an explainer about why we hear echoes? I remember wondering about that as a kid, so it feels like a fun thing to explain. What I have in mind is a 10-second vertical video with a voice-over, and I'd like you to write the words yourself. Please keep the explanation easy for kids to understand. You can choose the look, since I don't have a particular visual style in mind.

events.text:
I’ll make a colorful, vertical explainer with this kid-friendly voice-over:

“Why do we hear echoes? Sound travels in waves. When they hit a big, hard surface, they bounce back. That’s your echo!”
